name: @nmarijane/james-business
description: James Business — a French-speaking co-founder / business analyst agent for Claude Code. Ships with 8 companion skills covering the full early-stage lifecycle (validation, MVP scoping, GTM, market sizing, competitive analysis, metrics, financial modeling, team composition). Persistent project memory via .claude/james-state.md with intelligent merge (replace + archive for snapshots, merge-by-id for lists, append-only for decisions), long-term archive, and optional sync to Claude Code native memory. Self-contained, no external plugin dependency.
